title: Walla_Walla, NSW - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: Services for some customers in Walla Walla, NSW were interrupted due to a local power outage affecting an upstream access site. Service was restored at 11:36 AM AEST on 12 July 2026. We are monitoring. If your connection has not come back online, please restart your modem/router and any connection box (if you have one), or contact us for help.

updates.content: We’re aware of a service interruption that affected some customers in Walla Walla, NSW due to a local power outage at an upstream access site. Services were restored at 11:36 AM AEST on 12 July 2026. If your connection hasn’t come back online, please restart your modem/router and any connection box (if you have one). If issues persist, contact our support team and we’ll help get you back online.
